intro: Along Stormwind’s Canals near the Park, Caretaker Folsom tends the remains of a noble household. He once oversaw the Flintridge estate; now he sells what survived its bloody end.

p: Folsom followed his father into a life of service as caretaker of the Flintridge estate. That life ended with the massacre of the household. The manor stood abandoned, and its remaining funds eventually ran out. Left to watch over what remained, Folsom now sends the family's surviving heirlooms and possessions to auction.
